title: Lair Unguarded
summary: Recover three statues from Yar`Lir's guardians to open the northern gates.
overview: Recover three statues from Yar`Lir's guardians to open the northern gates.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Consolidate the statues on one player and react promptly to the whirlwind warning.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The Claws, Wings and Breath guardians appear at different randomly selected locations.
The gate check runs once a minute and unlocks when one client holds all three required statues.
When Breath of Yar`Lir warns that the whirlwind is focusing on you, crouch during the following five seconds to avoid its knockback.

notes: Approval E366. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The source labels the guardian location list possibly incomplete and notes the statue timer needs a quest reload after repop. Verify deployed spawns/reset behavior.
